title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr | 100% Remota | CLT

  • PLR;

  • Totalpass.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Customer Service / Sales Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our clients, partners, and internal teams. Your primary responsibility will be to help users throughout their experience on our platform, ensuring they can communicate smoothly and receive exceptional service. 


Responsibilities:  

  • Provide frontline support to clients during account registration, identity verification, deposits, withdrawals, and general platform use.

  • Track common questions and issues to help improve internal processes and FAQs. 

Qualifications:  

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service or sales support roles. 
  • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). 
  • Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented when dealing with customers. 
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce). 
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in fintech, digital platforms, or affiliate programs is a plus. 

What We Offer:  

  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities 
  • Supportive team culture 
  • Exposure to a global customer base and a fast-evolving industry 


Job type: Full-Time (Remote) 

Pay: $700USD/month

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.


This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.


You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: Cientista de Dados PL
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista de Dados PL em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho.


Responsabilidades:


- Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.

- Trabalho com Linguagens e Bibliotecas: Utilizar Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas e numpy, além de frameworks de NLP para desenvolver soluções eficientes e escaláveis.

- Integração de IA Generativa e LLMs: Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs) e IA Generativa, utilizando APIs e técnicas de prompt engineering para avaliação e integração de respostas em pipelines analíticos.

- Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura em Cloud: Atuar em ambientes de computação em nuvem, especialmente utilizando AWS, S3, SageMaker e Glue, para otimizar processos de dados e Machine Learning.

- Arquitetura de Soluções: Projetar e implementar soluções end-to-end, criando pipelines analíticos e integrando modelos em ambientes produtivos para maximizar a eficiência operacional.

Além das habilidades técnicas, o candidato deve possuir competências profissionais como comunicação técnica clara, autonomia para tomar decisões e a capacidade de atuar em contextos de negócios complexos.


Se você é apaixonado por dados e tecnologia, e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica que valoriza a inovação, se inscreva!

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FinCrime Escalations Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.

Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.

  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.

  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Clinical Study Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations

  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)

  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.


Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)
  • Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
  • Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).



Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora.
  • Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo.
  • Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos).
  • Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança.
  • Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes.
Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais
  • Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs).
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos.
  • Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: CX AI & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para CX AI & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About us

Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. We use AI to help our team work smarter, but we still care deeply about quality, clarity, and trust.


About the role

We are hiring a CX AI & Knowledge Manager to own the systems behind great support.

This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI , review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information.

You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work.


What you’ll own
  • Own and maintain the source of truth for support knowledge, product information, policies, and FAQs
  • Train, test, and improve Gorgias AI so responses are accurate, helpful, and on-brand
  • Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early
  • Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change
  • Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels
  • Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources
  • Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training
  • Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement


What success looks like in the first 90 days
  • Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup
  • Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents
  • Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions
  • Launch a simple QA process for AI responses
  • Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes
  • Make it easier for team members to find the right answer fast


What we’re looking for
  • 3+ years in customer experience, CX operations, knowledge management, support enablement, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or another support platform
  • Strong writing and editing skills
  • Experience building or maintaining a help center, FAQ library, or internal knowledge base
  • Comfortable reviewing support conversations and turning patterns into process improvements
  • Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information into clear guidance
  • Able to train people, not just tools


Bonus points
  • Experience in e-commerce, especially Shopify brands
  • Experience with AI support tools, automation, and QA workflows
  • Experience writing SOPs, training materials, or internal playbooks
  • Familiarity with product catalogs, product information, or merchandising workflows


Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful.



How to apply

Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions:

  • Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved.
  • Tell us about a time you trained or improved an AI or automation workflow.
  • How would you keep product information accurate across multiple teams?

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, Fabri Holdings emphasizes fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment. The company values individuals who are highly organized, solutions-focused, and eager to contribute to its ongoing success. title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • AI evaluation

  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

Benefits & Employment Structure

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions

Why Blueprint?

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;


Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)

Location: Brazil (100% remote)

Contract: PJ – Long Term


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems that directly influence key business initiatives.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and internal tooling
  • Contribute to user-facing applications that support listing, enrichment, and merchandising workflows
  • Write clean, performant, and testable code in a production environment
  • Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the platform
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders

  • Pair program and support team collaboration and onboarding
  • Deploy code to production with a strong focus on reliability and quality

Tech Stack

Java, Kotlin, Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, DynamoDB


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Experience building production-ready, scalable, and secure systems
  • Solid understanding of backend development and modern web applications
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and common development tools
  • Experience or interest in JVM-based services (Java/Kotlin)
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Knowledge of database fundamentals and API design (GraphQL or similar)
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with JVM services in production environments
  • Experience with modern frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into applications or internal tools
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems
  • Background in eCommerce platforms
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., Prismic)
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response
